recognize_zh: 左側有一顆比旁邊紅血球還大的血小板，含紫紅色顆粒與淡藍色周邊細胞質，右側另有一顆較小的血小板可對照，屬於巨大血小板，符合 Bernard-Soulier 症候群。
features: Giant platelet larger than adjacent red cells, with central purple granules and pale blue peripheral hyalomere
A smaller platelet at right for size comparison
Overlapping normochromic red cells in a thick area of the smear
Low image resolution limits assessment of granule detail
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells, some overlapping in a thicker area. A giant platelet exceeding the diameter of adjacent red cells is present, with central granules and a pale blue hyalomere, alongside a smaller platelet. Image resolution is limited. Findings are consistent with macrothrombocytopenia, supporting Bernard-Soulier syndrome in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context.

ddx.vs: MYH9 disorders show Dohle-like neutrophil inclusions and normal ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation.
ITP platelets are usually only mildly enlarged and GPIb-IX expression is normal.

ddx.dx: Overlapping platelet on a lymphocyte or small cell fragment
ddx.vs: A platelet lying on another cell shows a nucleus or two focal planes, whereas this is a single granular body without a nucleus.
